responsibility: Declares the Rust frontend’s identifier and object mapping infrastructure spanning AST, HIR, and definition space. It defines NodeMapping, which packages crate/node/HIR/local-def identity for a source entity, and the large Mappings singleton interface that manages id allocation plus insertion, lookup, and iteration APIs for crates, items, impls, traits, expressions, statements, patterns, canonical paths, lang items, macros, visibility, and module trees used throughout semantic analysis and lowering.
same_name_distinction: Declares the NodeMapping value type and the broad Mappings interface and owned maps used across AST/HIR/DefId bookkeeping; unlike gcc/rust/util/rust-hir-map.cc, it specifies the available mapping abstractions and members without implementing the allocation, insertion, and query logic.
